textos.anchor: Nutrition that moooves with your Cycle
textos.en: Nutrition that moooves with your Cycle
textos.es: Nutrición que fluuuye con tu ciclo

textos.anchor:
Ditch the cycle trackers, get your money’s worth. NutriSync isn't just another generic tracker, it's your cycle-smart nutrition guide, built for women who want more than logged data.
Join a growing community of women taking their nutrition seriously.
textos.en:
Ditch the cycle trackers, get your money’s worth. NutriSync isn't just another generic tracker, it's your cycle-smart nutrition guide, built for women who want more than logged data.
Join a growing community of women taking their nutrition seriously.
textos.es:
Deja los calendarios del ciclo: mereces algo mejor. NutriSync no es otro registro genérico, es tu guía de nutrición que entiende tu ciclo, hecha para mujeres que quieren algo más que datos apuntados.
Únete a una comunidad que se toma en serio lo que come.

textos.anchor: Men run on a 24 hour hormonal cycle; women on ~28 days across four distinct phases. Generic nutrition and training ignore that difference entirely, and our bodies quietly pay the cost of an unfair system.
textos.en: Men run on a 24 hour hormonal cycle; women on ~28 days across four distinct phases. Generic nutrition and training ignore that difference entirely, and our bodies quietly pay the cost of an unfair system.
textos.es: Los hombres funcionan con un ciclo hormonal de 24 horas; las mujeres, con uno de unos 28 días y cuatro fases distintas. La nutrición y el entrenamiento genéricos ignoran esa diferencia por completo, y nuestros cuerpos pagan en silencio el precio de un sistema injusto.

textos.anchor: Nutrition standards were never designed for a female body.
textos.en: Nutrition standards were never designed for a female body.
textos.es: Los estándares de nutrición nunca se diseñaron para un cuerpo femenino.
Más tarde que ellos en recibir un diagnóstico.

textos.anchor: Medical research skews male, raising risk for women across common medications
textos.en: Medical research skews  male,  raising risk for women across common medications
textos.es: La investigación médica se inclina hacia el cuerpo masculino: más riesgo para las mujeres en medicamentos de uso común

textos.anchor: Diagnosed ~4 years later than men on average — 4.5y later for metabolic conditions, 2.5y for cancer, 5–6y for conditions like ADHD
textos.en: Diagnosed ~4 years later than men on average — 4.5y later for metabolic conditions, 2.5y for cancer, 5–6y for conditions like ADHD
textos.es: Diagnosticadas unos 4 años más tarde que ellos de media: 4,5 años en enfermedades metabólicas, 2,5 en cáncer y 5-6 en cuadros como el TDAH

textos.anchor: No trusted, personalised guidance on food and movement across the cycle
textos.en: No trusted, personalised guidance on food and movement across the cycle
textos.es: Sin una guía fiable y personalizada de alimentación y movimiento a lo largo del ciclo

textos.anchor:
Your body cycles through different hormonal needs everyday.
NutriSync reads where you are across your cycle and adapts food and movement to match, automatically.
textos.en:
Your body cycles through different hormonal needs everyday.
NutriSync reads where you are across your cycle and adapts food and movement to match, automatically.
textos.es:
Tu cuerpo atraviesa necesidades hormonales distintas cada día.
NutriSync lee en qué punto del ciclo estás y adapta la comida y el movimiento a ese momento, automáticamente.

textos.anchor:
Estrogen and progesterone drop. Your body is resting, healing, and reflecting.
Slow down and clear the mental slate.
textos.en:
Estrogen and progesterone drop. Your body is resting, healing, and reflecting.
Slow down and clear the mental slate.
textos.es:
Los estrógenos y la progesterona caen. Tu cuerpo descansa, se repara y toma perspectiva.
Baja el ritmo y haz limpieza mental.

textos.anchor: Estrogen levels climb, sparking high mental clarity, creative focus, and physical stamina. Time to build and launch.
textos.en: Estrogen levels climb, sparking high mental clarity, creative focus, and physical stamina. Time to build and launch.
textos.es: Los estrógenos suben y traen claridad mental, chispa creativa y resistencia física. Momento de construir y lanzar.

textos.anchor: Estrogen peaks alongside testosterone. You feel highly social, confident, magnetic, and physically resilient.
textos.en: Estrogen peaks alongside testosterone. You feel highly social, confident, magnetic, and physically resilient.
textos.es: Los estrógenos llegan a su pico junto a la testosterona. Te sientes sociable, segura, magnética y físicamente resistente.

textos.anchor:
Progesterone dominates before dropping. Your energy winds downward.
Prioritize cozy self-comfort and boundary setting.
textos.en:
Progesterone dominates before dropping. Your energy winds downward.
Prioritize cozy self-comfort and boundary setting.
textos.es:
La progesterona manda antes de caer y tu energía va bajando.
Prioriza el cuidado, la calma y poner límites.

textos.anchor: No guessing, no one-size-fits-all. NutriSync brings food, movement and wellbeing into a single daily experience. Tuned to your cycle.
textos.en: No guessing, no one-size-fits-all. NutriSync brings food, movement and wellbeing into a single daily experience. Tuned to your cycle.
textos.es: Sin adivinar y sin talla única. NutriSync reúne comida, movimiento y bienestar en una sola experiencia diaria. Afinada a tu ciclo.
